_source: https://registry.modelcontextprotocol.io/v0/servers?search=<term>&limit=100 (up to 3 pages per term), queried in a real browser on 2026-11-23.
_method: A registry namespace is verified by the publisher (reverse-DNS needs domain proof; io.github.<org> needs GitHub org proof). We keep only servers whose namespace belongs to the vendor. Name collisions (e.g. com.twentyclubs, app.vercel.<someone's app>) were removed by hand.
_limits: Positive signal only. Absence from the registry does not mean there is no MCP (HubSpot, Slack, Salesforce publish elsewhere).
